meta.name: canva-mcp
meta.description: Complete Canva design automation via MCP tools. Use when user wants to create, edit, export, organize, or collaborate on Canva designs including presentations, social media posts, documents, and logos. Handles AI design generation, brand kit integration, multi-format export, and team collaboration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要制作演示文稿或社交图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate, edit, and export Canva designs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create presentations or social graphics without design skills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 MCP 工具操作你的 Canva:按描述生成设计(先给 4 个候选让你选)、搜索/读取现有设计、导出为 PDF 等格式、调整尺寸、管理文件夹和品牌工具包,还能评论和协作。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、编辑、导出或组织 Canva 设计(如演示文稿、社交媒体帖子、文档等),或进行协作时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Canva 里创建一个关于季度总结的演示文稿
say.note: 会先问是否用品牌工具包,再生成 4 个候选。

say.text: 搜索我最近的 Canva 设计
say.note: 按修改时间排序并显示缩略图。

say.text: 把这个设计导出成 PDF
say.note: 先列出可用格式,再给你临时下载链接。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate your Canva via MCP tools: generate designs from a description (offering 4 candidates to choose from), search/read existing designs, export to PDF and other formats, resize, manage folders and brand kits, and add comments for collaboration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, edit, export, or organize Canva designs (e.g., presentations, social posts, documents), or collaborate on them.

say_en.text: Create a Canva presentation about the quarterly summary for me.
say_en.note: It will ask about brand kit, then show 4 candidates.
Lists them sorted by modified time with thumbnails.

say_en.text: Export this design as a PDF.
say_en.note: Checks available formats and gives a temporary download link.
